// === CONFIGURATION ===
// Update these values for your setup

const config = {
  apify_token: 'YOUR_APIFY_API_TOKEN',
  location: 'Lee\'s Summit, Missouri',
  search_radius_miles: 30,

  // Apify actor IDs - replace with your preferred actors
  marketplace_actor: 'apify/facebook-marketplace-scraper',
  groups_actor: 'apify/facebook-groups-scraper',

  // Search queries for broken electronics
  marketplace_searches: [
    'broken PS5',
    'broken PlayStation 5',
    'PS5 for parts',
    'PS5 not working',
    'broken Xbox Series X',
    'broken Xbox Series S',
    'Xbox for parts',
    'Xbox not working',
    'broken Nintendo Switch',
    'Switch for parts',
    'Switch not working',
    'broken MacBook',
    'MacBook for parts',
    'MacBook not working',
    'broken laptop',
    'laptop for parts',
    'laptop not working',
    'broken gaming console',
    'console for parts'
  ],

  // Facebook group URLs to monitor
  group_urls: [
    'https://www.facebook.com/groups/YOUR_LOCAL_MARKETPLACE_GROUP_1',
    'https://www.facebook.com/groups/YOUR_LOCAL_MARKETPLACE_GROUP_2',
    'https://www.facebook.com/groups/YOUR_LOCAL_ELECTRONICS_GROUP'
  ],

  // Keywords to look for in group posts
  group_keywords: [
    'broken', 'not working', 'for parts', 'cracked screen',
    'won\'t turn on', 'dead', 'damaged', 'repair',
    'doesn\'t work', 'needs repair', 'as-is', 'as is',
    'defective', 'faulty', 'water damage', 'bricked'
  ]
};

return { json: config };
